meta.dataset: Synthetic example (invented chest-CT reports; no patient data)

links_meta.method: claim extraction + Hungarian matching (reporttools, from radmetric), aggregated to sentence pairs

meta.note: Synthetic example pool: invented chest-CT reports, no patient data, safe to redistribute. Two studies -- the first with three candidates (a model-style report, an error-injected copy of the reference and a retrieved report from another invented case), the second with one -- so the interface can be tried before any real pool exists. Built with scripts/generate_fallbacks.py, scripts/build_pool.py and scripts/precompute_links.py. Replace with data/cases.json for a real study.

reference.clinical_information: Cough and fever for one week.
reference.technique: Non-contrast axial CT of the chest, 1.5 mm sections.
reference.findings:
Trachea and both main bronchi are patent.
There is consolidation with air bronchograms in the right lower lobe.
A small right pleural effusion is present, measuring 14 mm in depth.
No pulmonary nodule is seen in the left lung.
Mediastinal lymph nodes are not enlarged.
Heart size is normal and there is no pericardial effusion.
No lytic or sclerotic bone lesion is seen.
reference.impression: Right lower lobe pneumonia with a small right pleural effusion.

reference.clinical_information: Follow-up of a known lung nodule.
reference.technique: Non-contrast axial CT of the chest, 1.5 mm sections.
reference.findings:
A solid, smooth nodule measuring 8 mm is seen in the left upper lobe.
Mild centrilobular emphysema is present in both upper lobes.
No consolidation or pleural effusion.
The mediastinum and hila are unremarkable.
reference.impression: Solid 8 mm left upper lobe nodule. Mild emphysema.

candidate.text: A nodule is seen in the left upper lobe. Emphysematous changes in both lungs. No effusion. Mediastinum normal.
